Security Policy

Reporting a vulnerability

We appreciate reports of security vulnerabilities. Please do not create a
public issue for security-sensitive reports. Instead, report security issues
privately via GitHub's Security Advisories (https://github.com/sponsors) or
use the GitHub Advisory Database / security reports flow.

We do not publish a public security contact email for this project. Use the
GitHub security report flow or the GitHub Advisory Database to submit
vulnerability reports.

Supported versions

We actively maintain and provide security patches for the latest release and
the previous release. If you discover a security issue in an unsupported
release, please report it and we will advise on remediation steps.

Disclosure timeline

After we receive a report, we will:

1. Acknowledge receipt within 3 business days.
2. Triage the report and assign a maintainer to investigate.
3. Work with the reporter to verify the issue and prepare a fix.
4. Coordinate disclosure and release a fix in a timely manner.

Please note that these timelines may vary depending on the severity and
complexity of the issue.

How we handle security reports

We will attempt to keep the reporter informed during the investigation and
remediation process. We may request additional information or ask for
assistance reproducing the issue. We will credit the reporter for responsible
disclosure in the release notes unless the reporter requests anonymity.

Acknowledgements

We thank the security community and responsible researchers for helping us
keep Ghost secure.
